title: VERY OUTDATED app! Get a new 2025 (AI MATH APP) instead… 4 years ago this was great, but not in 2025
text:
As a mathematics graduate student spending 5 years in college taking all advanced Calculus 1-3, Trig, & Algebraic Reasoning Theory & Proof, Adv. Stats & Probability, & all other courses…..  this app is honestly bottom of the line for everything except graphing when compared to other similar AI Math Apps.

I l rank this app #10 in my Top 10 Best Math Apps. It’s good for assisting with certain math content area, but horrible with others. The paid subscription on here is definitely NOT worth the money 💵

Nearly all other similar math apps (8 of 10) on my list … offer (college & high school students) actively taking math courses a DISCOUNT OF 25-60% monthly or yearly subscription plan. This app offers NO discount!! 

Outdated… Behind this apps paywall they definitely 💯 need to create MAJOR UPGRADES, UPDATES, & ADD UPPER LEVEL MATH COURSES, OPTIONS, STUDENT PRICING, & MORE… IF… this company or app has a MICRO CHANCE of being in business in the next 1-2 years. 

There are 9 different apps that HANDS-DOWN offer so much better math solving, step-by-step solutions, & can provide downloadable (LeTex or pdf) entire question-to-answer printable links 🔗 to use for hands-on practice including math notes. 5 years ago this was a top 3 app, but sadly and honestly, it’s not even a top 10 app anymore and not on any math professors recommended assistance lists as of (October 29, 2025). I haven’t seen any professors use this app in class for 2 years, but other apps they do use & recommend are unbelievably better , faster, can handle complex advanced math problems including full math proofs, and are compatible to integrate into Canvas too. 

Maybe the owner will have developers complete overhaul this OUTDATED app to compete with 2025 major math apps, but if not, I honestly predict this app will cease to exist or stop all future updates with 2 years. Again, 3-4 years ago this app was incredibly helpful, but as we’re 2 months away from 2026… this app is honestly similar to an old outdated (iPhone-3) as compared to (new AI math apps) that are like 2025 (iPhone-17-Pro). This app unfortunately is VERY OUTDATED, but used to be amazing 3-4 years ago!

Thank you for being great 4 years ago honestly, however all outdated apps have no use in today’s incredibly amazing AI math app world that does 3 times more mathematics and cheaper monthly subscription PLUS others offer STUDENT DISCOUNT PRICE!

title: Calculator does not properly handle parenthetical statements
text:
Calculator does not follow the rules of clearing parentheses in an equation. Example:

84 / 3(3+4) =

The correct answer is 4. 3+4 = 84 / 3(7). 7*3 = 84 / 21. 84 / 21 = 4.

The calculator does not clear parentheses. It does 84 / 3 = 26. 26 * 7 = 196. This is the solution to equation 84 / 3 * (3+4), not 84 / 3(3+4). As you can clearly see the two equations are clearly differing in solution.

This failure to properly follow the rules of math lead students with low proficiency in calculating to wrong answers when inputting parenthetical expressions.
